title: NASA-UAP-D4, Apollo 11 Technical Crew Debriefing, 1969
doc_notes: This is a technical crew debriefing transcript for the Apollo 11 mission containing reports of unidentified visual phenomena and cabin light flashes.

encounters.summary: Apollo 11 crew observed an unidentified object while in translunar flight, initially mistaking it for the S-IVB stage. The object appeared to have an L-shape or hollow cylinder structure and was seen tumbling.
encounters.quote: It was a hollow cylinder. But then you could change the focus on the sextant and it would be replaced by this open-book shape.

encounters.summary: Astronauts observed unexplained light flashes inside the spacecraft cabin during sleep periods, which they speculated might be atomic particles or radiation penetration.
encounters.quote: It did give you a rather funny feeling to contemplate that something was zapping through the cabin.
